title: Toward SLM-based agentic task-tool intent matching
title_zh: 迈向基于 SLM 的智能体任务-工具意图匹配

paragraphs.en: SLM-Agents: 1st Workshop on SLMs for Agentic Systems
paragraphs.zh: SLM-Agents：面向智能体系统的SLM首次研讨会

paragraphs.en: Tool-equipped AI agents use tool calls to access data and act on external systems. Horizontal growth of agentic systems increases the number of these interactions, and further motivates the need for automated, per-call oversight that can operate at low latency and/or on-prem. Conventional authorization schemes can determine whether an agent is allowed to invoke a tool, but cannot assess the agent’s underlying cognition, specifically, whether the tool selection represents a logical, relevant step toward satisfying the intent of the task or not. Consequently, an allowed call may still deviate from the task’s intent: a rogue agent might deviate the calls or nudge other agents to make a combination of calls that would not align with the intent of the task. Therefore, every call needs to be verified. In this study we investigate the applicability of Small Language Models (SLMs) to this purpose: an SLM functions as a task-tool relevance classifier that evaluates every selected tool independently against the assigned task and returns a relevance signal for downstream enforcement. Equipped with a novel dataset with multi-tool tasks whose required tools span distinct Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, we used prompt-optimization, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning through GRPO to optimize and specialize SLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 配备工具的 AI 智能体通过工具调用访问数据并对外部系统执行操作。 智能体系统的横向扩展增加了此类交互的数量，并进一步催生了对自动化、逐次调用的监督机制的需求，该机制需具备低延迟和/或本地部署的能力。 传统的授权方案可以判断智能体是否被允许调用某个工具，但无法评估智能体的底层认知能力，特别是其工具选择是否构成满足任务意图的逻辑且相关的步骤。 因此，即使被允许的调用仍可能偏离任务的意图：恶意智能体可能会篡改调用流程，或引导其他智能体执行一系列与任务意图不符的联合调用。 因此，每一次调用都需要经过验证。 在本研究中，我们探讨了小型语言模型（SLM）在此场景下的适用性：SLM 可充当任务与工具相关性分类器，独立评估每个选定的工具与指定任务的相关性，并返回一个相关性信号以供下游执行机制使用。 我们构建了一个包含多工具任务的新数据集，其中所需工具覆盖了不同的模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器，并通过提示优化、监督微调以及基于 GRPO 的强化学习来优化和专业化这些小型语言模型。

paragraphs.en: Our work extends Task Based Access Control (TBAC) to intent-based TBAC: broadly, TBAC dynamically activates, tracks, suspends, consumes, and revokes permissions as the authorization steps of a task progress Thomas and Sandhu (1998) . In other words, a permission is available only when required by the current stage of an active task, and only for its authorized lifetime and usage. However, the original TBAC does not determine whether a tool semantically matches a user’s or an agent’s natural language intent. Furthermore, classical TBAC assumes that the tasks, workflow steps, dependencies, and permissions have been explicitly modeled. In agentic systems, however, due to the enormous flexibility of natural language, explicit modeling of these components ahead of time becomes impossible.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作将基于任务访问控制（TBAC）扩展为基于意图的 TBAC：总体而言，TBAC 会随着任务的授权步骤推进而动态激活、跟踪、暂停、使用和撤销权限 Thomas and Sandhu (1998)。 换言之，只有当当前活跃任务的阶段需要时，权限才可用，且仅在其授权的有效期和用途内有效。 然而，原始 TBAC 并未判断某个工具是否在语义上与用户或智能体的自然语言意图相匹配。 此外，经典 TBAC 假设任务、工作流步骤、依赖关系和权限都已被显式建模。 但在智能体系统中，由于自然语言具有极大的灵活性，提前对这些组件进行显式建模变得不可能。

paragraphs.en: In order to assess semantic relevance of a tool to a given task a system needs to inspect both the subject query as well as the tool descriptions. Cloud-based, frontier LLMs with reasoning capability are effective for analyzing these calls (see the results section). However, in many organizations, concerns over privacy, cost, latency or organizational policies limit the practical applications of these models. The hypothesis for our study is that optimizing an SLM for this purpose is sufficient to achieve high accuracy while satisfying the operational constraints. † † Code and data are available at https://github.com/outshift-open/outshift-casa-slm

paragraphs.en: Classification objective. Given our labeled task-candidate pairs 𝒟 = { ( q i , c i , y i ) } \mathcal{D}=\{(q_{i},c_{i},y_{i})\} , we formulate task-tool relevance as a binary classification problem. The classifier receives the task q q and the candidate tool’s name and description and produces a structured output from which a boolean prediction y ^ ​ ( q , c ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } \hat{y}(q,c)\in\{0,1\} is parsed. A false positive allows an irrelevant tool, whereas a false negative rejects a tool required by the task; broken outputs are logged as parsing failures.

paragraphs.en: SFT. Using the optimized prompt, we trained LoRA Hu et al. (2021) adapters ( r = 32 r=32 , α = 64 \alpha=64 ) on 4404 4404 class-balanced, single-tool ASTRA examples and selected the checkpoint on 1136 1136 validation examples. We treated single-tool tasks as a lower-complexity curriculum stage because they expressed direct task-tool relationships without the compositional dependencies of multi-tool tasks. We masked prompt tokens and minimized cross-entropy over the model response. Training used AdamW with a peak learning rate of 1.9 × 10 − 4 1.9\text{\times}{10}^{-4} , 10 10 % warmup, three epochs, an effective batch size of 64 64 , and a maximum sequence length of 1024 1024 in bf16 . To select the hyper-parameters, we used TPE sampler (Tree-structured Parzen Estimator) in Optuna Akiba et al. (2019) , optimizing for validation set’s F 1 F_{1} .
paragraphs.zh: SFT。我们使用优化后的提示，在 4404 个类别均衡的单工具 ASTRA 示例上训练了 LoRA Hu et al. (2021) 适配器（r = 32 r=32，α = 64 \alpha=64），并在 1136 个验证示例中选择了最佳检查点。我们将单工具任务视为一个复杂度较低的课程学习阶段，因为它们直接表达了任务与工具之间的关系，而不存在多工具任务中的组合依赖。我们对提示词标记进行了掩码处理，并最小化了模型响应的交叉熵。训练过程中使用了 AdamW 优化器，峰值学习率为 1.9 × 10 − 4 1.9\text{\times}{10}^{-4}，设置了 10% 的预热阶段、三个训练周期、64 的有效批量大小以及 bf16 格式下 1024 的最大序列长度。为了选择超参数，我们使用了 Optuna Akiba et al. (2019) 中的 TPE 采样器（树状 Parzen 估计器），以验证集的 F₁ F_{1} 作为优化目标。

paragraphs.en: GRPO. Starting from the F 1 F_{1} -selected SFT checkpoint, we applied GRPO to a class-balanced mixture of single-tool, same-MCP multi-tool, and cross-MCP multi-tool examples ( 9485 9485 training and 2927 2927 validation). The deterministic reward combined schema compliance, label correctness, and a penalty for excessive reasoning; false positives and false negatives were penalized equally, and invalid outputs received an additional penalty. We did not use an LLM-based reasoning judge. We updated the LoRA adapters and sampled 16 16 responses per prompt at temperature 1.1 1.1 . We optimized the Dr. GRPO Liu et al. (2025) objective with sequence-level importance sampling, batch-scaled group-relative advantages, and a KL penalty of β = 10 − 3 \beta=10^{-3} . Training used a learning rate of ​ 10 − 5 {10}^{-5} for three epochs at an effective batch size of 256 256 in bf16 ; prompts and completions were capped at 1024 1024 and 192 192 tokens, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: GRPO。我们从 F 1 F_{1} -选择的 SFT 检查点开始，将 GRPO 应用于一个类别平衡的混合数据集，该数据集包含单工具、相同 MCP 多工具和跨 MCP 多工具示例（9485 个训练样本和 2927 个验证样本）。确定性奖励结合了模式合规性、标签正确性以及过度推理的惩罚；假阳性和假阴性受到同等惩罚，无效输出则受到额外惩罚。我们没有使用基于 LLM 的推理判断器。我们更新了 LoRA 适配器，并在温度 1.1 的情况下为每个提示采样了 16 个响应。我们通过序列级重要性采样、批量缩放组相对优势以及 KL 惩罚项 β = 10^{-3} 优化了 Dr. GRPO Liu et al. (2025) 的目标函数。训练过程中，学习率设为 10^{-5}，共进行三个周期，有效批量大小为 256（使用 bf16）；提示和补全分别最多为 1024 个和 192 个词元。

E2E accuracy was computed over the complete test set, with malformed or unparseable outputs counted as incorrect predictions. All other classification metrics were computed from successfully parsed Boolean predictions, with failed parses reported separately. We obtained 95 95 % bias-corrected and accelerated confidence intervals from 10 000 10\,000 paired bootstrap resamples. A server with a single H100 GPU was used for all three steps of the optimization.

paragraphs.en: SLM: Overall performance. Specialization improved both model sizes. For Gemma 3 1B, GEPA did not improve validation performance, so the seed prompt was retained and no separate GEPA result was evaluated on the held-out test set. SFT increased accuracy from 61.59 61.59 to 80.06 80.06 and F 1 F_{1} from 66.74 66.74 to 81.82 81.82 , although parse failures increased from 103 103 to 175 175 , limiting E2E accuracy to 78.63 78.63 . GRPO largely resolved this issue, reducing parse failures to one while increasing E2E accuracy to 89.60 89.60 and F 1 F_{1} to 91.39 91.39 . For Gemma 3 4B, performance improved at every stage of the sequential pipeline (Table 1 ). GEPA increased E2E accuracy and F 1 F_{1} by 4.10 4.10 and 4.07 4.07 percentage points (pp), respectively; SFT added 2.20 2.20 and 1.56 1.56 pp, and GRPO a further 2.35 2.35 and 1.92 1.92 pp, yielding cumulative gains of 8.65 8.65 and 7.55 7.55 pp.

paragraphs.en: Error trade-off across stages. The stages affected false positives and false negatives differently (Figure 1 ). For Gemma 3 1B, SFT substantially reduced the false-positive rate from 38.76 38.76 to 6.86 6.86 , while GRPO reduced the false-negative rate from 27.87 27.87 to 11.61 11.61 , at the cost of a modest increase in false positives to 8.37 8.37 . For Gemma 3 4B, GEPA reduced the false-negative rate from 15.89 15.89 to 5.30 5.30 , but increased the false-positive rate from 6.92 6.92 to 13.39 13.39 . SFT restored selectivity, reducing false positives to 6.95 6.95 while retaining most of the recall gain. GRPO produced the best balance, with false-positive and false-negative rates of 5.42 5.42 and 2.94 2.94 , respectively. Thus, GEPA prompt optimization, SFT, and GRPO made complementary contributions.

paragraphs.en: While frontier LLMs can meet the 95 95 % operational target (GPT-5.6 Sol achieved an accuracy of 98.58 98.58 %), both SLMs initially performed well below this threshold, with E2E accuracies of 60.94 60.94 % and 87.48 87.48 % for Gemma 3 1B and 4B respectively. Sequential specialization, however, substantially improved the performance of both model sizes. After GRPO, Gemma 3 1B reached 89.60 89.60 % E2E accuracy, remaining below the operational target, whereas Gemma 3 4B reached 96.13 96.13 %, slightly surpassing it. Although our evaluation is limited to synthetic, LLM-curated task-tool pairs and two model sizes from a single family, these results support our hypothesis that specialized SLMs can provide a viable operational alternative to frontier models for intent-based TBAC in agentic systems.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管前沿 LLM 能够满足 95% 的运行目标（GPT-5.6 Sol 的准确率达到 98.58%），但两种 SLM 最初的表现均远低于这一阈值，其中 Gemma 3 1B 和 4B 的 E2E 准确率分别为 60.94% 和 87.48%。 然而，顺序专业化显著提升了两种模型规模的性能。 经过 GRPO 后，Gemma 3 1B 的 E2E 准确率达到 89.60%，仍低于运行目标；而 Gemma 3 4B 则达到了 96.13%，略微超过了该目标。 尽管我们的评估仅限于合成、由 LLM 筛选的任务-工具组合以及单一模型家族中的两种模型规模，但这些结果支持了我们的假设：在智能体系统中，针对意图型 TBAC 任务，专业化的 SLM 可以为前沿模型提供可行的运行替代方案。
